extra_description.text: Your heart beats like a steam hammer.

description.text: ✦ Shield Wall: while blocking, allies near you take 25% less damage; axes can't disable your shield

extra_description.text: An immovable wall of meat and iron.

description.text: ✦ Ironclad Upkeep: armor wears 50% slower; full set regenerates out of combat

extra_description.text: Every piece of armor counts for more.
Quality gear, worn by someone who knows how.

description.text: ✦ Last Stand: survive a lethal hit at 1 HP (5 min cooldown)

extra_description.text: You do not die when you should.
Mobs lose track of you; your name fades from sight.
Spells slide off you like rain off oilcloth.
Boiler explosions are a mild inconvenience.
Nothing moves you that you don't allow.
Whatever strikes you comes away sluggish.
Your soul network pays your wounds. Costs LP per hit absorbed.
Bad air, smoke, water — you take less of it in.
Every blow lands like a piston.

description.text: ✦ Executioner: double damage below 20% HP; non-bosses below 10% die

extra_description.text: The rhythm of the line, applied to skulls.

description.text: ✦ Cleave: melee hits splash 30% damage around the target, any weapon

extra_description.text: Surround yourself with a ring of steel.
When you find the gap, it ends.
It tastes like copper and victory.

description.text: ✦ Bloodrush: kills stack +5% attack speed and damage for 8s (max 5)

extra_description.text: Every wound you open closes one of yours.
Damage dealt feeds your soul network.
Keep them at the end of your weapon.
Enchanted protection unravels under your blade.
String to cheek in a heartbeat.

description.text: ✦ Ricochet: arrows bounce once to another enemy within 6 blocks

extra_description.text: Any projectile, thrown, fired or launched.

description.text: ✦ Hunter's Mark: your first hit makes a target glow and take +20% damage for 10s

extra_description.text: They never see where it came from.
Pick the eye. Hit the eye.

description.text: ✦ Long Shot: projectile damage grows with distance, up to +50% at 40 blocks
✦ Dash: press the Dash key to burst forward with brief invulnerability

extra_description.text: Mud, snow, soul sand — all the same to you.
Crouched and quick as a rat.
Walk straight up a full block.

description.text: ✦ Wall Cling: hold sneak against a wall to slide slowly; jump to kick off
✦ Double Jump: jump once more in mid-air

extra_description.text: Hang in the air a little too long.
The flooded tunnels hold no fear.

description.text: ✦ Auto-Smelt: 50% chance mined ores drop their smelted result
✦ Prospector's Sense: press its key to outline ores within 12 blocks through walls

extra_description.text: Vein mining barely dents your hunger.

description.text: ✦ Treasure Hunter: 1% chance of bonus loot when mining stone

extra_description.text: The ruins always have one more good thing in them.

description.text: ✦ Hex: hits have a 25% chance to stack Weakness and Wither

extra_description.text: Your foci answer faster and harder.

description.text: ✦ Arcane Ward: a 4-12 point absorption shield that refills out of combat
✦ Soul Siphon: kills heal you (and feed your NeoVitae soul network)

extra_description.text: Your own blood is worth more to the altar.
Somebody has to build the place.
The whole field, not just the row you're standing in.

description.text: ✦ Baby animals within 8 blocks grow ~3x faster

extra_description.text: Calves, chicks and lambs grow up fast around you.
Your machines work harder when you're watching.
Every gear, every piston, a little faster.
The whole workshop hums at your pace. Create machines are never affected.

description.text: ✦ Stoker: furnaces near you burn fuel 50% longer

extra_description.text: Up the scaffolding and back down without a scratch.
Tear down a house in the time it took to build one wall.
Falls off roofs are a thing of the past.

description.text: ✦ Pulls items and XP within 5 blocks (toggle: Item Magnet key)

extra_description.text: Drops find their way to you.

description.text: ✦ Pulls items and XP within 10 blocks

extra_description.text: Everything you drop, and everything you break, comes home.

description.text: ✦ Regeneration I within 24 blocks of your bed/respawn point

extra_description.text: You work faster in your own workshop.
Hunger is for people who take breaks.

description.text: ✦ In the Foundry: Soul Siphon, Arcane Ward and Hex (see Hollow Sight)

extra_description.text: It wore your face. Now you wear what it kept.
Earned by putting down what waits in the Hollow

description.text: ✦ Soul Siphon, Arcane Ward and Hex, wherever your path ran
Only while the Foundry holds you (locked in its vision)

extra_description.text: The Foundry lends you what it took from them.
Capstone • Opens and closes with the vision

description.text: Only while you look through the Foundry Lens

extra_description.text: What you let go of, you only borrow back.
Healthy as an ox, stubborn as one too.
Hard to hit, harder to pin.
Find the gap and widen it.
Blisters long since turned to leather.
Follow the seam wherever it runs.
Something of you stays behind the blow.
The bang arrives. You mostly don't.
Hit me and see what sticks.
Doors and skulls both give way.
Even the gravel keeps your secret.
Bend the knees, bend the rules.
The current is on your side.
A good spanner outlasts its owner.
Eight hours and a clear conscience.
Never quite where the blow lands.
The wall opens for those who earn it.
The road to the front begins here.
It jumps when you aren't looking.
Where the front gives way to the treeline.
It knows where you will be.
All the power, none of the padding.
Whoever lands the first blow lands the last.
The path forks; the arrows don't.
Dust, gravel, and an honest day.
Reads the rock like a book.
See it from here, dig it from there.
Dig far enough and the walls whisper.
The vein wants to be found.
Knowledge weighs more than it looks.
Wound by hand, driven by will.
Past the red line, and humming.
Hum of gears, hum of something else.
Home is where the fire is.
